name: – After § 1 – Am 2
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Georgia’s worsening democratic crisis following the recent parliamentary elections and alleged electoral fraud
part_text: 1a. Emphasises Georgia’s right, as a sovereign state, to adopt laws that reflect the democratic will of its citizens, even if such laws might affect the country’s EU accession process; calls for the EU to respect Georgia’s legislative autonomy, while ensuring a dialogue based on mutual respect and the non-imposition of external values;
